description_en: Changes the resource group for a cloud resource
description_zh: 通过云资源的资源 ID修改云资源所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun computenest change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id si-5dc794a7fd254e000000 --new-resource-group-id rg-acfmzmhzo000000 --resource-type service --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud resource whose resource group you want to change
parameters.help_zh: 需要修改资源组的云资源的资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination resource group.

You can obtain the resource group ID from the Resource Management console (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups)
parameters.help_zh:
要移动到的资源组ID。

您可以通过资源管理控制台 (https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups)查看资源组ID
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

service: The resource is a service.

serviceinstance: The resource is a service instance
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。可能的值：

service：服务。

serviceinstance：服务实例
parameters.name: resource_type
